## Feature contract

The staged design renews two reef membrane catches (2 units per 6 active minutes) and two Canopy resin pockets (2 per 10 active minutes), capped at original exposed stock. Finite sorting reserves, minerals, island drift resin, food and recovery retain their rules. Integer progress advances only during active post-opening simulation, including while a region is not drawn. No pause/menu/offline/load catch-up, no banked progress at a full cap and no clamping down legitimate stock above the cap. Sorting to capacity clears progress in that same transaction. Keep the original rates unless a concrete composition defect requires correction; recommendations for later tuning are welcome.

Schema4/expedition.5 must validate old schema3 against its original domain before migration, initialize only new renewal progress to zero, preserve old state/investment/poses/knowledge/stock/clocks and refuse malformed current saves atomically. Earlier schema1/2 validation remains historically correct. Save/read/import must not create materials. Current migration fixtures keep their behavioral/conservation assertions; do not weaken them to clear failures.

Current recipes retain real blueprint/site/material/capability gates. Distinguish future plans from buildable recipes. The progression matrix should remain honest about implemented versus planned systems. Do not add future hull recipes or rescale the world merely to make the matrix look finished. The target remains seven habitats across about 2.0×1.8 km; this task completes renewal on the current benchmark. M2-B will deliver the Basin-funded capability payoff, second membrane habitat, fleet/mobile-home progression and broader routes. Both eventual strategies must remain solvent with **zero renewal credited**; neither mandatory progression nor recovery may require waiting.
